title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at point B as 4 m/s for h=2.4 m, using kinematics or energy on the incline.

title: Condition for Left Fall
description: Essential: Correctly states the condition for the block falling left of the belt as h < 3.0 m, based on energy loss before point D.

title: Condition for Right Projection
description: Essential: Correctly states the condition for horizontal projection from point D as h ≥ 3.6 m, based on the centripetal condition at D.

title: Distance x Relation
description: Important: Derives the correct functional relationship x = 2√(h - 3) m, linking release height to landing distance via energy and projectile motion.

title: Incline Acceleration
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law or energy correctly to find the block's acceleration or energy loss on the inclined track AB.

title: Energy Analysis on Belt
description: Important: Correctly accounts for the work done against friction on the horizontal conveyor belt segment of length L.

title: Projectile Time
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time of fall from height H+2R to the ground for the horizontal projectile motion.

title: Sign of Friction Work
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the work done by friction (should be negative/energy loss) in the energy balance.

title: Centripetal Condition
description: Pitfall: Misapplies or omits the condition (mg ≤ mv²/R) for the block to maintain contact and project from point D at the top of the wheel.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds) throughout the calculation and final expressions.
